tagline: Request a data consultation with Steward Data Group.

copy.headline: Request a data consultation
copy.lead: Describe where your data lives and what you need from it. You will see an initial recommendation straight away, and a reply from the {shortName} team within one business day.
copy.goalHint: Which systems and spreadsheets hold it, and what is going wrong.
copy.goalPlaceholder: e.g. Customer data sits in three systems and a dozen spreadsheets, and nobody trusts the totals.
copy.finePrint: Please do not include passwords, keys or customer data.
